D: A former special ops hero comes out of retirement to stop his nemesis from stealing a nuclear warhead.
P: Serve the snacks when MacGruber puts the team together.
S: MacGruber taking his car stereo everywhere

Cashews, almonds and peanuts roasted with chilli, honey, rosemary and sea salt, served warm with strips of beef jerky. Toss 400g mixed raw nuts with 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp chopped rosemary. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring twice, until golden. Sprinkle with 1 tsp sea salt flakes while hot and cool for 10 minutes so the coating crisps. Serve in a bowl next to 150g sliced beef jerky.
Emergency celery with blue cheese dip

Crisp celery and carrot sticks with a chunky blue cheese and buttermilk dip and a drizzle of buffalo hot sauce on top. Mash 100g blue cheese with a fork, then mix in 100g sour cream, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 3 tbsp buttermilk, 1 tsp lemon juice and black pepper, leaving some chunks. Chill for 30 minutes. Trim 1 bunch celery and 2 carrots into long sticks and keep them in iced water until serving so they stay crisp. Spoon the dip into a bowl, drizzle with 1 tbsp hot sauce and serve with the drained sticks.
M: Action hero rib eye with onion rings

Chargrilled rib eye with garlic herb butter, a stack of crunchy soda-battered onion rings and a peppery rocket salad. Mash 60g butter with 1 crushed garlic clove and chopped parsley. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 250ml cold soda water into a batter. Slice 2 large onions into thick rings, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Season 4 x 300g rib eye steaks and grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side for medium rare. Rest 5 minutes, top with the butter and serve with rings and rocket.
W: racing the clock on the stolen X-5

Rich dark chocolate and cream pots that set fast in the fridge, topped with whipped cream, flaky salt and crushed honeycomb. Heat 300ml thickened cream with 2 tbsp caster sugar until just steaming. Pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate, leave 1 minute, then stir until smooth and glossy. Whisk in 1 egg yolk and a pinch of salt. Pour into 4 small glasses and chill for at least 1 hour until set. Top each with a spoon of whipped cream, a pinch of sea salt flakes and 30g crushed honeycomb.
K: Vicki, MacGruber's partner in the field

Ice-cold lager mixed with lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire in a chilli salt rimmed glass. Mix 1 tbsp sea salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a saucer. Run a lime wedge around the rims of 4 pint glasses and dip into the salt. Fill with ice. Add the juice of half a lime, 60ml tomato juice, 2 dashes hot sauce and a dash of Worcestershire to each glass. Top each with a 330ml bottle of cold lager, stir gently and serve with a lime wedge.
